decisions.reason: The source decision is scoped to the downward-facing bottom side of the sensor board and does not necessarily impose the same component-minimization policy on the main board.
The source concerns the sensor board's inaccessible bottom side, not the independently oriented power board.
Minimizing bottom-side components does not change the required connector inventory, connector types, pinouts, or connector count.
The mechanical placement policy does not change the SPS30 SEL-to-GND electrical requirement.
The sensor-board bottom-side placement policy does not alter the main board's connector inventory or sensor-board connection definitions.
The source does not change the main-board I2C resistor value, topology, purpose, or population policy.
Sensor-board component-side placement does not change the monitored rails, monitor IC, channel allocation, or current coverage.
The source applies to the sensor board and does not modify the power board's battery connector placement or electrical interface.
The sensor-board placement constraint has no necessary effect on the charge-status connector, resistor configuration, or indicator behavior.
Reducing components on the sensor board's bottom side does not change the board-chain order, power rails, connectors, or forwarding behavior.
Connector pin markings are not components, and the source does not remove or relocate the required bottom-side labels.
The sensor-board mechanical placement policy does not affect the main-board LED supply, logic levels, model, or power-control behavior.
